The '''Garde d'Azure''' was the [[Planetary Security Forces|security force]] of the [[Azure sector/Legends|Azure sector]] during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> Their military prowess was such that it was known by the wider galaxy. 

==Behind the scenes==
Garde d'Azure means "Guard of Azure" in French.
